annotations.title: Graduating in Japan: when to change from student visa, job-hunting visa, part-time end, 14-day notice

description: Dated checklist for an international student graduating in Japan, from ISA guidance as of 2026-11-10 (留学→就労資格 notice 10_00240, 在留資格変更許可申請 16-2, 継続就職活動 and 内定者 特定活動 pages, 2026-10-01 fee table, school guidance on part-time after graduation). plan: job_offer (needs jobStartDate; April starts → ISA asks for filing 1 Dec–31 Jan, otherwise aim 2 months before start; file with 卒業見込み証明書, collect card after graduation; 内定者 特定活動 for long gaps: hire within 1 year of offer and 1 year 6 months of graduation) | job_hunting (継続就職活動 特定活動, 6 months + 1 renewal, university / 専門士 grads with recommendation; language-school grads only with foreignBachelor) | leaving | further_study. Always: part-time on 留学 permission ends at graduation; report leaving the school within 14 days. Returns verdict (too_early | open | urgent | applied | not_eligible | expired | info), summary, targetStatus, windowOpens, recommendedBy, lastDay, partTimeEnds, notifySchoolLeftBy, jobHuntingUntil, hireBy, fee, deadlines, actions, warnings, sources, disclaimer. Use for 'when to change student visa to work visa Japan', 'April start visa application December', 'can I work part-time after graduation in Japan', 'job hunting visa after graduation Japan', '留学 就労ビザ 変更 いつから', '継続就職活動 特定活動'. Educational, not immigration advice; not affiliated with ISA or any school.

expectedGrantMonths.description: Period expected to be granted, for the fee (default 12; job hunting 6).

foreignBachelor.description: Language-school students: holds a foreign bachelor's degree.

jobStartDate.description: Job start date, YYYY-MM-DD (required for job_offer).

plan.description: What happens after graduation (default job_offer if jobStartDate is given, else job_hunting).

school.description: university (incl. graduate school, junior college) | vocational (専門学校 / 専門士) | language_school | other. Default university.

studentExpiry.description: 留学 period-of-stay expiry on the residence card, YYYY-MM-DD.
